title: Slash
tagline: They come from both sides. Cut the right way, at the right moment.
controls: `Left` and `Right` arrow keys cut left and right. `A` and `D` work too.
On a phone: tap the left or right half of the panel.
Cut too early or the wrong way and you take the hit. Three hits and it is over.
about:
A reaction game. Enemies charge in from the left and the right; you cut the side they are on, but only once they are inside the strike zone. Swing early and you are wide open.

Every clean cut builds a combo, and the combo is the score. It gets faster. It always gets faster.

A round takes about a minute. You will want another one.
